parts.name: Evaporation
parts.quote: Evaporation is the change of state in a substance from a liquid to a gas.

parts.name: Transpiration
parts.quote: Transpiration is the evaporation of water from plants through stomata.

parts.name: Condensation
parts.quote: Condensation is the process whereby water vapor is changed into a liquid state.

parts.name: clouds
parts.quote: In the atmosphere, condensation may appear as clouds or dew.

parts.name: Precipitation
parts.quote: Precipitation can be in the form of rain, hail, snow, or sleet.

parts.name: Runoff
parts.quote: Runoff occurs when there is excessive precipitation and the ground is saturated (cannot absorb any more water).
